questions.question: Full-Mark Response Analyse how three different artworks or designs use design principles. For each, identify at least three principles and explain how they create meaning or effect. Create your own composition that deliberately uses (or challenges) these principles. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: identify specific design principles at work in each piece; explain HOW each principle creates effect (not just name it); compare different uses of the same principle; create a personal composition showing intentional use of principles; annotate with specialist vocabulary; evaluate the effectiveness of their compositional choices. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
